design: Broad athletic adult female guard with bronze-olive hide, strong exposed mandibled face and pronounced high two-lobed cranium, long dreadlocks woven with small leather bindings over one shoulder. Guard armor based on overlapping dark hexagonal plates, modest wide chest structure, short practical charcoal fabric hip skirt, heavy bronze bracers and light shin wraps. Holds a long narrow riot shield at left side that reveals body and a sheathed baton at belt, head turned slightly right watching street. Calm patrol stance.
